scripts.text:
[Battle Therapist]
Just close your eyes,
and take a deep breath.
You can be free from pain.
scripts.translation:
[战斗治疗师]
闭上双眼，
深呼吸。
你可以摆脱痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Axl Rose]
Why are you here, Croix mercenary? I am definitely sure of victory against foolish Croix such as you. Ha!
scripts.translation:
[阿克塞尔·罗斯]
克洛艾的佣兵，你为何在此？我确信能战胜你们这些愚蠢的克洛艾人。哈！

scripts.text:
[Swandery]
Why do you come here as a Guillaume? You will be sent to where you should be!
scripts.translation:
[斯万德里]
你为何以吉约姆的身份前来？你会被送回你该去的地方！
